exam.title: Salesforce Certified Platform Developer
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is published; Salesforce describes a typical candidate as having one to two years of development and at least six months on Lightning Platform. Practice a limit-aware and secure lifecycle across data/access design, Flow and bulk Apex, SOQL/SOSL/DML, LWC and Visualforce, deterministic tests, diagnosis, source-driven deployment and rollback.

review.notes: All four published domains are mapped through limit-aware architecture/data/access, declarative and bulk Apex interaction, SOQL/SOSL/DML, secure LWC/Flow/Visualforce, deterministic tests, evidence-led diagnosis and source-driven deployment/rollback. Three scenarios, eight authorized labs and 40 original checks are included. Complete indexed official text confirms the contract, 27/28/25/20 weights and objective snapshot; the Summer '25 label remains a visible watch. A March 2026 Apex Hours LWC-security lab is community context, not scope. No recalled/live item, dump, shared superbadge solution or copied course content is used.

findings.title: Database security defaults are versioned
findings.evidence: API67+ user-mode operations enforce CRUD/FLS/sharing; explicit system mode retains class sharing context. WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED removed.
findings.recommendation: Teach explicit modes, API-version upgrades and denied-persona tests.
findings.resolution: Teach explicit modes, API-version upgrades and denied-persona tests.

findings.title: Specific trigger release note conflicts with roundup shorthand
findings.evidence: Specific note distinguishes trigger without-sharing context from user-mode default database operations at API67; roundup says triggers bypass sharing/FLS.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

findings.title: Trusted URLs do not authorize arbitrary CDN script loading
findings.evidence: First-party Lightning CSP requires external JavaScript libraries as org static resources; community article suggests CDN loading.
findings.recommendation: Correct learning guidance and avoid treating community sample as production-ready.
findings.resolution: Correct learning guidance and avoid treating community sample as production-ready.

findings.title: DOM HTML filtering is not input validation
findings.evidence: LWS explicitly does not sanitize arbitrary input text.
findings.recommendation: Separate browser sink handling, input validation and server authorization.
findings.resolution: Separate browser sink handling, input validation and server authorization.

findings.title: A collection implementation must process every batch and bound data access
findings.evidence: Lesson supplies collection and grouped query/DML pattern and 200-record batches.
findings.recommendation: Execute original 400-record calculator with traced read counts, replay and changed configuration; propose actual Apex evidence.
findings.resolution: Execute original 400-record calculator with traced read counts, replay and changed configuration; propose actual Apex evidence.

findings.title: Per-operation and final transaction outcomes differ
findings.evidence: Partial Database results and caught operation errors require enclosing-transaction interpretation.
findings.recommendation: Execute controlled partial commit, caught atomic operation and later-fatal rollback cases.
findings.resolution: Execute controlled partial commit, caught atomic operation and later-fatal rollback cases.

findings.title: Accepted asynchronous work needs outcome evidence
findings.evidence: Queueable returns job ID; test boundaries and chain-depth support have specific contracts.
findings.recommendation: Require operation/job/record correlation and avoid untested claims about all downstream jobs.
findings.resolution: Require operation/job/record correlation and avoid untested claims about all downstream jobs.

findings.title: Developer-assistant product naming has changed
findings.evidence: Current page distinguishes Agentforce Vibes Extension formerly Agentforce for Developers from Vibes IDE formerly Code Builder.
findings.recommendation: Preserve blueprint wording and provide current lookup names without expanding exam scope.
findings.resolution: Preserve blueprint wording and provide current lookup names without expanding exam scope.

public_objective_groups.title: Developer Fundamentals
objectives: Understand multi-tenant concepts and design frameworks, such as MVC architecture and Lightning Component Framework.
Given a scenario, identify common use cases and best practices for declarative versus programmatic customizations, including governor limits, formula fields, and roll-up summaries.
Given a scenario, determine, create, and access the appropriate data model including objects, fields, relationships, and external IDs.
Understand use cases and limitations of using Agentforce for Developers.

public_objective_groups.title: Process Automation and Logic
objectives: Identify the capabilities of the declarative process automation features.
Understand how to declare variables, constants, methods, modifiers, Apex interfaces, and the appropriate use cases for each.
Given a scenario, assess how Apex control flow statements will execute and when to apply different control flow statements.
Given a scenario, write SOSL, SOQL, and DML statements in Apex, and assess what they will return.
Given a scenario, follow best practices to write Apex classes and triggers.
Given a scenario, understand governor limits and their implications on Apex transactions.
Describe the relationship between Apex transactions, the save order of execution, and the potential for recursion and/or cascading.
Implement exception handling in Apex, including custom exceptions as needed.
Given a scenario, use declarative functionality and Apex together to automate business logic.

public_objective_groups.title: User Interface
objectives: Given a scenario, prevent user interface and data access security vulnerabilities.
Given a scenario, display and use custom user interface components, including Lightning components, Flow, and Visualforce.
Describe the use cases and best practices for Lightning Web Components, including the framework, benefits, and events.
Given a scenario, implement Apex to work with various types of page components, including Lightning components, Flow, and Agentforce.

public_objective_groups.title: Testing, Debugging, and Deployment
objectives: Write and execute tests for triggers, controllers, classes, and flows using various sources of test data.
Given a scenario, know how and when to use the Salesforce Developer tools such as Salesforce DX, Salesforce CLI, and Developer Console.
Describe how to approach debugging system issues and monitoring flows, performance, asynchronous, and batch jobs.
Describe the environments, requirements, and process for deploying code and associated configurations.
